grid.expression: SELECT F.NOME AS TECNICO, --COUNT(CASE WHEN ASS.DTCONCLUSAO IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS EM_ABERTO, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASS.DTCONCLUSAO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS FINALIZADA, COUNT(ASS.NUMOS) AS TOTAL_OS FROM AD_TGFASS ASS LEFT JOIN AD_CADFUNC F ON NVL(ASS.TECNICO,0) = F.IDFUNC WHERE TRUNC(ASS.DTCONCLUSAO, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(ASS.DTCONCLUSAO, 'YYYY') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') --AND ASS.TECNICO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.NOME ORDER BY F.NOME
